items.text: Learning without thinking is of no use.
Ms Chen writes the sentence on the blackboard and says, “Please write this down.”
I write down the first word and stop.
But is it OK to point out the mistake?
Is that polite, in the first lesson?
Questions jump into my mind.
I look up at Ms Chen.
My eyes meet hers.
But then I think about the meaning of the sentence.
I put up my hand.
“Ms Chen, there’s a mistake,” I say.
That sentence is from Confucius, not from Mencius.
You need to think more in your learning.
Speaking up in the first lesson is a problem for Wang Han.
In the first English lesson, Ms Chen writes a sentence on the blackboard and asks us to write it down.
I begin to write, but I stop after the first word.
Questions jump into my mind.
But then I think about the meaning of the sentence.
I put up my hand.
“Ms Chen, there’s a mistake,” I say.
Ms Chen says yes and that is the first lesson for everybody.
Learning will be more difficult, so we need to think more in our learning.
In the first English lesson, Ms Chen writes a sentence on the blackboard and asks the students to write it down.
Wang Han starts to write, but he soon stops.
He finds something wrong with the sentence.
He wants to point out the mistake, but he is not sure.
Is it polite to do that in the first lesson?
Many questions jump into his mind.
He looks up at Ms Chen and feels nervous.
Then Wang Han thinks about the meaning of the sentence.
At last, he puts up his hand and says, “Ms Chen, there’s a mistake. That sentence is from Confucius, not from Mencius.”
Ms Chen smiles and says, “Well done, Wang Han.”
She says, “In fact, this is my first lesson for all of you.”
In junior high school, learning will be more difficult.
Students need to think more in their learning.
For Wang Han and his classmates, it is really an important lesson.
Welcome to Students’ Union Radio!
The new school year is beginning.
What are the new student’s problems?
Let’s take a look.
For many years, the biggest problems is: They have more subjects and more homework.
They also have many activities.
So how can they make good use for their time?
Mia, how do you feel about your first day in junior high tomorrow?
Well, I’m a little nervous.
Don’t worry.
We’ve got something for you!
We want to share some thoughts with you.
Time flies!
Are you ready for your new life?
Primary school is like a small pool.
Dad and Mum can protect your boat from winds.
But junior high is like a river.
You will face new problems.
But sometimes you have to sail your boat by yourself.
Just try your best and work hard.
You will go through storms towards the sea.
One way is to face problems bravely.
Before junior high starts, Mia got a letter from Dad and Mum.
Primary school is like a small pool.
Mia’s boat is safe there, and her parents can protect her boat from winds.
But junior high is like a river.
It is wide and the water moves fast.
Mia will face new problems.
Her parents are still there to help, but sometimes she has to sail her boat by herself.
She should try her best and work hard.
Then she can go through storms towards the sea.

Mia says she is a little nervous.
Mum tells her, “Don’t worry.”
